steps.content: Sink. Endless sinking, with all the guests and the island.
The water plants growing beneath the island continue to grow upwards, weaving into hands that lift the entire island, as if stretching out to touch the island and join in the revelry.
Colorful corals and reefs surround the island, and those unknown, strangely shaped marine creatures, with viscous liquid rolling over their bodies, also secretly watch this paradise.
The guests gently land on the "beach". Only after a moment's pause, they stagger to their feet again and walk forward on the soft gravel.

steps.speaker: Gym Hunk
steps.content: Ha... haha... I'm not done yet! Come on, continue to admire my muscles...!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Miser
steps.content: Money! Where is my money?! Give it to me! Give it to me!
People have no time to care about anything else, the interrupted revelry needs to resume immediately. They struggle to stand up and head to the enjoyment scene they just left.

Some stretch out their hands, grabbing the first person they touch to play with them, and some snatch the unfinished dishes on the table and stuff them into their mouths. Some jump back into the pool of coins instantly to enjoy their favorite coin bath again.
And L.L. swims among the crowd, no longer needing to use digital avatars as guides, nor borrow Manty's eyes.

Elysiland sinks to the bottom of the sea, the whole world soaked in the sea of pleasure. Now L.L. can finally leave that luxurious pool, feeling as carefree as a fish returning to the ocean, embracing a larger world.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Haha... hahaha! The atmosphere is indeed better live, a thousand times more enjoyable than watching a live stream!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Now I'm here, we can be happy together! Share your passion and joy with me too!
Moments later, a viscous liquid flows from all directions, like a mixture of several syrups, has covered the ground, red and white, warm and sticky underfoot.
The Black Tide was also Adelaide's doing? That bastard...

The black water plants growing beside Elysiland are as excited as the guests, wrapping around the island more tightly, seemingly wanting to pull the island down to the seabed. L.L. immerses herself in all this, letting it all develop freely.
She smiles, dancing lightly in the water, joining the whirlpool of joy initiated by every person who reaches out to invite her.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes... teach me, let me also try what it feels like to have the smoke of burning money enter my lungs...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: How well does it match with the liquid melted from those coins?

L.L. raises a glass filled with golden liquid and slowly pours the solution onto the guest's chest. After instant corrosion, melting, and solidification, the guest pulls out a heart that shines like gold.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Miser
steps.content: Hahaha! Hahahaha! It suits me perfectly.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Miser
steps.content: A perfect person like me should be wealthy from head to toe! More! More! Let me stand on equal footing with those born rich, gaining everyone's respect without spending a penny!
While waiting for the coins to boil into a thick soup, L.L. is invited to the VIP seat, watching the food being continuously delivered like an assembly line.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I've never seen such a lavish feast before. Look at you all drooling... is it really that good? Is it worth making your stomachs so round and full without stopping?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Gourmet
steps.content: Of course! No matter what, people can't give up eating. Even the saddest person needs to eat. Being well-fed is the primary source of happiness for living beings! The pinnacle of gourmet food is the pinnacle of life!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Gourmet
steps.content: You too, come and try! A top-notch dessert is enough to make a beautiful girl like you happy!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hehe, inviting you here was definitely the right decision. I've never seen this before.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Quick, teach me! How should I eat—I mean, how should I savor the dishes to feel the "pinnacle of life"?

steps.speaker: Elysiland Gourmet
steps.content: The essence of a dish is always in one bite, but here, the dishes keep coming, right?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hehe, of course! Now, let's toast to this endless joy!

After drinking it all, the guests at the table swallow the food delivered to them one bite after another. Those delicious, nutritious, plant and animal carcasses pass through their throats, clogging their stomachs.
Their elegant heads keep chewing, while their lower bodies swell like balloons.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Gourmet
steps.content: This is something you can only enjoy on Elysiland!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Gourmet
steps.content: No matter how much you eat, you never get full, and there's always more!
L.L. laughs heartily with them but can no longer eat another bite. Fortunately, the guests are all immersed in the food, not caring about her departure.
L.L. swallows the happiness surging from her stomach to her throat, cradling her face, and looks at everything in front of her with satisfaction.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: This is what Elysiland should truly look like! It's what I've always imagined!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Whatever can gives you pleasure, whatever brings you such addictive joy, show it all to me!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Share with me everything that makes you happy and addicted, let me be happy too!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I've brought everyone joy, so from now on, you'll bring me joy!
L.L. walks step by step to the center of the island, passing by everyone, enjoying the ultimate spiritual joy they bring her.

Gorging without feeling full, endless money—these are just the simplest satisfactions on Elysiland. Those who crave forbidden emotions, limitless physical satisfaction, desires to control the life and death of an individual or even a nation, those hard-to-understand, despised, and even morally and legally questionable desires...
Here, you can easily taste the flavor of your wishes coming true.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hah... now... isn't it worth dying for?
